name: Dr. Radhika Joshi
review: The bespoke bridal polki necklace we crafted at Pukhraj Jewellers was the absolute centerpiece of my daughter's wedding. Their transparency in gold purity and weight calculations gave us complete peace of mind.

name: Sameer & Ananya Kulkarni
review: Choosing our engagement solitaire here was an unmatched experience. The personalized attention, IGI certification guidance, and zero-pressure consultation made our choice effortless and sacred.

name: Sunita Deshmukh
review: For over three generations, our family has trusted Pukhraj for all our Dhanteras and Akshaya Tritiya gold purchases. Their traditional Maharashtrian designs and BIS hallmarked purity are peerless.

name: Amitabh Agrawal
review: Purchased an astrological Ceylon Yellow Sapphire ring. The gemological certification, custom gold setting, and clarity explanation were top-tier. Highly recommended for genuine gemstones.
